displayDescription: Torn-paper cutouts on a slate planning board: an idea bulb lights, folded cards unfold and kraft strips unroll to join them into one system.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22 (WebGL) compositing torn-edge paper sprites, fold meshes and Graphics strips
Rough.js 4.6 (seeded) inking the four node-card icons onto Canvas 2D textures
Canvas 2D procedural paper textures: white torn core, stock colour, fibre grain, pre-blurred contact shadows, stationary slate field
chroma-js palette validation and contrast checks
motionEngine: Procedural Paper Curl and Fold Deformation implemented on a PixiJS MeshGeometry strip (cylindrical crease + straight flap, front/back face split) re-derived from rest UVs and the timeline fold angle each draw
GSAP 3 paused timeline registered at window.__timelines.video: sole owner of every animated value (placement, lift, fold angle, unroll progress, held filament poses via steps(3))
limitations: Silent preview: no music, voice or sound effects were created.

No reviewed preview recipe exists in STYLE.json (tech.preview_recipes absent, optional recipes list empty); the preview demonstrates the primary Cutout Animation style plus the requested source-frame background refresh.

Paper fold and roll are artistic procedural deformations (orthographic cylinder curl with slight size-by-depth scaling), not a physical paper solver; lighting is an alpha shading approximation, not real 3D lighting.
Torn edges, fibre grain and contact shadows are seeded procedural simulations, not scanned or photographed paper.
Rendered with PixiJS instead of Three.js for the fold: the same rest-vertex deformation is applied to a 2D mesh, which suffices because the fold axis is in-plane; there is no free 3D camera.
Canvas-rendered copy is not DOM-inspectable; contrast was resolved in code with chroma.contrast (ink #3B3C34 on cream #F0E5D0, 8.94:1). The slate field carries no text.
PixiJS Application.init is asynchronous; frames redraw on every timeline seek and on hf-seek once the WebGL renderer is ready.
Background review used only sampled stills from two sources; source subjects, wording and colours were not copied.
Blender was not used, per user instruction.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA pending.
